# Shell completion

<p class="cli-lead">Tab completion for bash, zsh, fish and PowerShell.</p>

`clavis completion <shell>` prints a completion script for your shell.

## Examples

<p class="cli-example-title">zsh</p>

```sh
clavis completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_clavis"
```

<p class="cli-example-title">bash</p>

```sh
clavis completion bash | sudo tee /etc/bash_completion.d/clavis > /dev/null
```

<p class="cli-example-title">fish</p>

```sh
clavis completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/clavis.fish
```

<p class="cli-example-title">PowerShell</p>

```sh
clavis completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
```
